name: MERF Baking
definition: A post-training procedure to evaluate and store the MLP's outputs on discrete grids for real-time rendering, using a binary 3D grid to cull empty or occluded voxels based on training ray contributions.
summary: MERF Baking converts neural fields into block-sparse textures for real-time web rendering, using proposal-MLP sampling to eliminate artifacts found in uniform baking pipelines.
